# **Figure 1. Participant flowchart**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false
readRDS(here("output/table_exclusion_funnel.rds"))
```

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-flowchart
%%| fig-cap: "Participant flow, NHANES August 2021 to August 2023."

flowchart TD
    A["Adults aged 20 years and older,<br>NHANES August 2021 to August 2023<br>n = 7,809"]
    B["Aim 1 sample<br>n = 4,124"]
    C["Aim 2 sample<br>n = 2,308"]
    D["Included in adjusted models<br>n = 2,043"]

    E1["Excluded (n = 3,685)<br>Without two reliable dietary recalls: 3,524<br>Without a measured BMI: 47<br>Implausible energy intake: 24<br>Pregnant or breastfeeding: 36<br>Underweight: 54"]
    E2["Excluded (n = 1,816)<br>Without ALT values: 371<br>Liver disease: 228<br>Hepatitis B: 37<br>Heavy alcohol consumption: 1,180"]
    E3["Excluded (n = 265)<br>Missing covariate data: 265"]

    A --> B --> C --> D
    A -.-> E1
    B -.-> E2
    C -.-> E3
```
